problems: The blind guess (bird, hooded figure, small head on top) does not identify a hull. The top reads as a fin on a narrow peak, not a boat. The bottle/bell alternative is closer, but the shape still does not read as a vessel.
The dome is a narrow peak rather than a wide convex upturned hull. Shoulders 69996 (~191,232) and 68002 (~305,264) sit far apart vertically, so the top looks pointed.
The keel fin is a thin spike. Its base 68282 (~292,195) sits well above the crown 68523 (~280,220), so the fin does not rise cleanly from the hull's crown.
The stern tip 65810 (~418,380) is a sharp point, not the rounded stern the part list asks for.
Labels collide: the stern-tip label overlaps the starboard waterline label near 67234, and the 'bright starboard lamp' label overlaps the aft belly lamp label. The image is hard to read.
Stray unlabelled stars sit at the left and top-left (~112,334; ~155,212; ~183,208). They are not in the key list and add clutter.

Blue and gold lines run along different paths around the hull, especially the blue line from the port waterline to the belly lamp and the blue stern run. Two outlines make the silhouette ambiguous. The gold outline should be the single readable shape.

Parts are mostly on the right stars (fin tip, masthead lanterns, shoulders, waterlines, three belly/stern lamps), and the figure is upright with the fin pointing up. The stars are placed correctly; the problem is the silhouette drawn between them.
